title: Depth of a combined circuit
statement: For any number $n$ of variables, any Boolean gate type, and any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on those variables, the depth of the circuit obtained by combining the list is at most the maximum depth in $cs$, plus $\lceil\log_2 |cs|\rceil+1$, where the maximum depth of an empty list is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
